notes.title: Demo V0.4
notes.notes:
Greetings Legends! 

[list]
[*] Enemies and Items now despawn after you leave their radius. This is an attempt to resolve a build up in performance costs resulting in FPS drops whilst playing for consecutive hours.
[*] Added a gathering notification.
[*] Item Labels will be properly removed when releasing space bar.
[*] Camera rotation now happens continuosly whilst holding down the relevant buttons.
[*] Reduced overall loot drops.
[*] Moved camera out slightly.
[*] Improved Lighting.
[*] Improved Foliage coverage.
[*] Prevented overlapping sounds from spiking the volume.
[*] Sutr can no longer wield weapons in his offhand.
[*] Added NPC "greetings" audio.
[*] Temporarily removed enemy respawning whilst I resolve issues related to it. If you want to farm a particular enemy or group of enemies, you will need to relog.
[*] Added Attribute details to the stats panel.
[*] Improved readability on stats panel.
[*] Gold is now a lootable object on the floor that auto pickups when you move over it.
[/list]

I hope you guys like the changes we have made and cannot wait to hear your feedback! Happy hunting Legends :)  Sam & Leon

notes.title: Demo V0.3
notes.notes:
Greetings Legends! 

[list]
[*] Added 13 new stats: 
[*] -Primary Attack Speed (increases the rate of primary attack animations)
[*] -Primary Attack Damage (increases the damage dealt by primary attacks)
[*] -All Resist (increases every resistance by this amount)
[*] -Dodge (chance to completely avoid damage from a hit)
[*] -Parry (chance to reduce damage from a hit by 50%)
[*] -Block Chance (chance to Block)
[*] -Block Amount (% reduction of damage taken when Blocking)
[*] -Magic Find (chance to find an item of higher rarity)
[*] -Item Find (chance to find an item when killing enemies, every 100% guarantees an additional item)
[*] -Gold Find (increases amount of Gold gained from killing enemies)
[*] -Cooldown Reduction (reduces the Cooldown of Skills that have Cooldowns)
[*] -Effect Duration (increases the Duration of Buffs and Effects)
[*] -Item Effectiveness (increases the effectiveness of Items)
[*] Esc now closes the World Map and any Zone Maps.
[*] "M" now closes Zone Maps alongside the World Map.
[*] Further overhauls to the UI.
[*] Added gold drops on enemies killed.
[*] Removed the flicker generated on item tooltips when hovering over an item on the ground.
[*] NPC's quest icon will now be removed from the minimap once all their quests have been completed.
[*] Added a "Death" message - this will be expanded in the future to include a recap.
[*] Fixed a bug with Black Tusk Orc Magur not attacking.
[*] Added footfall VFX/SFX to Bragi, Loki and Ymir.
[*] Fixed a bug with overlapping sounds becoming louder.
[*] Further improved lighting in the Open World.
[*] Added a "Universe" Map, this will later be expanded upon into an Endgame gameplay system.
[*] Added item comparison tooltips for Equipped vs Unequipped items.
[*] Removed Companions - they will return in the future in a more fleshed out form.
[*] Added level requirements to items.
[*] Improved the way loot drops are calculated, every enemy now has the chance to drop bonus loot (currently Uniques, but will be expanded in the future), at a set drop rate.
[*] Added 2 new Unique Items - Charging Fury and Fleeting Touch.
[*] Updated Stats UI.
[/list]

I hope you guys like the changes we have made and cannot wait to hear your feedback! Happy hunting Legends :)  Sam & Leon

notes.title: Demo V0.2.1
notes.notes:

Just a little hotfix here to address the "falling through the world" bug and add a couple more bits and pieces :)

[list]

[*] Updated more UI elements.

I hope you guys like the changes we have made and cannot wait to hear your feedback! Happy hunting Legends :)  Sam & Leon

notes.title: Demo V0.2
notes.notes:
Greetings Legends! 

It's been a few months since the last update and we have been hard at work, with many drastic overhauls and changes being worked on at once. We have also been busy networking at attempting to setup as many different events around the Kickstarter timeline, in order to help us grow and spread the word.

More of that in a future update though, for now, the patch notes:

[list]
[*] Added equipabble weapons to character selection.
[*] Increased starting attributes for all classes (leaning in the favour of their role).
[*] Increased HP of all enemies and reduced Damage of all enemies.
[*] Changed camera angle to a more traditional one.
[*] Improved FPS (again).
[*] Added the first dynamic encounter: Grizzle.
[*] Added 2 more combat sounds to Bears and Wolves - gradually trying to find that sweet spot!
[*] Tutorials now pop up as "?" under the minimap, you can then click to expand them.
[*] Added a slight "sparkle" vfx to loot.
[*] Added Loot Chests to the world.
[*] Added a "Fog of War" to the minimap and world map.
[*] Removed the day and night cycle temporarily to allow myself more time to focus on gameplay.
[*] Added dynamic lighting.
[*] Revamped the world so it's more cohesive and follows the "Open World Multiplayer ARPG" philosophy. 
[*] Began UI revamp, starting with HUD, Minimap, Zone Map, World Map and Inventory panels.
[*] Added Sutr to the game.
[*] Revamped enemy AI to allow for more exciting combat (mostly to come later) and clean up stuttering issues.
[*] Items can now be picked up by clicking on their labels.
[*] Fixed multiple issues with item labels and loot filter.
[*] Temporarily removed Odin.
[/list].

I hope you guys like the changes we have made and cannot wait to hear your feedback! Happy hunting Legends :)

Sam & Leon

notes.title: Demo V 0.1.5
notes.notes:
[h3]Demo V 0.1.5[/h3]

Thank you for the continued play testing and support! This patch addresses some bugs and optimisation issues that have been reported to me.

[list]
[*] Improved FPS by at least 20% (up to about 50% in some areas). On my testing PC I went from around 50 FPS on Cinematic settings to around 70 FPS in the most FPS intensive areas.
[*] Improved movement.
[*] Put Quest Tracker behind Skill Tree.
[*] Spirit Guardians unlock at level 10: "Spirit Guardians are companions that will follow you, attack Enemies and even sell your loot for you! You can only have 1 Companion at a time".
[*] Increased Item Gold Value by rarity.
[*] Increased Cost of Items purchased at a Vendor.
[*] Slightly reduced base movement speed.
[*] Removed "green swirl" from some UI elements.
[*] Changed zone intro UI.
[*] Added "spend points" to level up UI.
[*] Increased roam radius of all Enemies.
[*] Increased zoom on Minimap.
[*] Added "farewell" text to some NPC's that were missing it, this resolves the "blank space" issue.
[*] Summons that don't have Health (Guardians and Loki Clones) can no longer be targeted.
[/list]

If anyone has any additional feedback, there are multiple channels you can go through including 

email: legendsofvalhalla@hotmail.com
forums: https://www.legendsofvalhallagame.com
discord: https://discord.gg/ycE9vjHp5b

and of course the discussions boards here on Steam. Happy looting, until next time :)

Sam

notes.title: Demo V 0.1
notes.notes:
[h3]Demo V 0.1[/h3]

This first patch addresses all the feedback that has been gathered thus far. It's been a great couple of days and I have really enjoyed hearing about everyone's first experiences with the game, and I hope to see some people reach Endgame soon, to see what you think of that content!

[list]
[*]Adjusted lighting to try and make shadows lighter whilst retaining the "gritty yet vibrant" overall approach I am aiming for.
[*]Info pop up's have been spaced out a little more to try and not overwhelm new players with info.
[*]Added a portal to the start of Morsci's Dungeon in case you entered, got scared, and couldn't leave.
[*]Added a confirmation window to deleting Characters.
[*]Reduced chances of finding higher rarity items. As players level they gain a hidden "natural buff" to magic find, allowing them higher chances of finding higher tier items. This equates to a 0.0011% chance to drop a Legendary, a 0.031% chance to drop an Epic and a 0.101% chance to drop a Rare at level 1 and a 0.006% chance, 0.08% chance and 0.15% chance at level 50 (max level). This chance also translates to items sold by Vendors.
[*]Increased all stackable items to 100 max stacked. This will greatly improve inventory management.
[*]Added a preliminary loot filter that enables players to show/hide items based on their stats. This will be expanded to include item types.
[*]Added a "range explanation" button to the combat info pop up, and better expressed Range and Radius in Skill Descriptions.
[*]Slightly reduced the Radius for Loki's Ingenuity.
[*]Added a movement marker.

[/list]

If anyone has any additional feedback, there are multiple channels you can go through including 

email: legendsofvalhalla@hotmail.com
forums: https://www.legendsofvalhallagame.com
discord: https://discord.gg/ycE9vjHp5b

and of course the discussions boards here on Steam. Happy looting until next time :)

Sam
